- Remove prop drilling from App.tsx

Benefits:
- Cleaner component code with no prop drilling
- Better separation of concerns (state logic separate from UI)
- Type-safe state management
- Easier to extend with new features

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add visual crop tool, multiple palettes, and history feature

New Features:
- Visual crop tool with react-easy-crop library
  - Interactive dragging and zooming for cropping
  - Better UX compared to text input fields
- Output size controls with slider interface
- 6 color palette presets:
  - Sunset (original warm gradient)
  - Monochrome (grayscale)
  - Vibrant (rainbow colors)
  - Pastel (soft tones)
  - Earth Tones (natural colors)
  - Ocean (deep blue to cyan)
- History feature to save and reload recent brickifications
  - Saves up to 10 recent versions
  - Click thumbnails to restore previous work
  - Stores image, dimensions, and palette used

UI Improvements:
- Fixed canvas display size with max-width styling
- Added pixelated rendering for better pixel art display
- Added labels and headers for better organization
- Improved ColorPalette component with preset selector
